footer.blurb: Ancestral natural cider, biodynamic orchards, and rustic open-fire dining set deep in the mist-crowned valley of Aramaio.
footer.reachingBody: Nestled at the foot of Mount Anboto. Accessible via the A-2620 scenic pass. 35 minutes from Vitoria-Gasteiz and 50 minutes from Bilbao and Donostia-San Sebastián.

orchardStages.alt: Heritage Basque cider apples ripening on moss-draped orchard branches.
orchardStages.title: Native Cultivars
orchardStages.body: Polyculture orchards planted with 14 rare Basque cultivars: high-tannin Urtebi Txiki, acidic Moko, and bitter Gezamina. Trees are dry-farmed without synthetic intervention.

orchardStages.alt: Hand-harvested cider apples gathered into woven baskets on dewy orchard grass.
orchardStages.title: Hand Gathered by Kizkia
orchardStages.body: Fruit is allowed to drop naturally at peak phenolic maturity, harvested individually using the ancestral spiked wood pole (kizkia), ensuring only pristine fruit enters the press.

orchardStages.alt: Antique chestnut cider barrels aging in a stone cellar with lantern light.
orchardStages.title: Wild Kupela Aging
orchardStages.body: Slow, spontaneous double fermentation in seasoned 10,000-liter chestnut and oak casks (kupelak). The cold mountain air naturally stabilizes the liquid into sparkling life.

menuCourses.name: Tortilla de Bacalao con Puerros
menuCourses.detail: Free-range eggs, salt cod flakes, caramelized Aramaio garden leeks

menuCourses.name: Bacalao Frito con Pimientos de Gernika
menuCourses.detail: Line-caught Cantabrian cod, confit garlic, sweet Gernika peppers

menuCourses.name: Txuleton de Vaca Vieja a la Brasa
menuCourses.detail: 45-day dry-aged Basque grass-fed ribeye seared over aged vine wood embers and coarse sea salt

menuCourses.name: Queso Idiazabal con Membrillo y Nueces
menuCourses.detail: Raw Latxa sheep cheese from Gorbeia, homemade orchard quince jelly, toasted walnuts

experiences.alt: Guests walking through a Basque apple orchard beneath limestone mountains.
experiences.title: Guided Orchard & Cellar Walks
experiences.body: Stroll the biodynamic terraced groves, learn ancient pruning arts, and finish in the cellar with a guided tasting of three single-variety natural reserves.

experiences.alt: Visitors operating a wooden hand-screw cider press during harvest.
experiences.title: Harvest & Pressing Immersion
experiences.body: Gather heritage apples with the kizkia, operate the 1912 wooden hand press, and bottle your own cloudy unfermented sagarmustia to take home.

experiences.alt: Candlelit communal table set for a private gathering in the barrel cellar.
experiences.title: Celebrations in the Kupelategi
experiences.body: Intimate banquets, milestone gatherings, and bespoke corporate retreats surrounded by century-old oak and the gentle perfume of natural cider maturation.
